source_commit_binding: new authorization direct child of source commit, adding only new receipt

allowed_scientific_calls.float_and_saved_metadata_comparison: same result JSON; same snapshot existing other rank records only, no new rank computation

payload_path: unmodified _partition_hash first assignment AST expression; UTF-8 sorted compact JSON; no newline; actual source function cross-check
evidence_order: write actual canonical bytes, full payload, float repr/hex and hash identity before expected hash comparison
comparisons: bitwise float.hex equality; no tolerance, rounding patch, replacement-field/hash search or version exploration

classification_rules.HASH_MATCH_VERIFIED: actual == expected and fixed source/canonical byte checks pass
classification_rules.HASH_MISMATCH_CAUSE_PARTIALLY_IDENTIFIED: mismatch plus differing available saved fragment metadata; direct original payload absent so no unique causal attribution
classification_rules.HASH_MISMATCH_UNRESOLVED: mismatch with no differences in available saved fields
classification_rules.HASH_MISMATCH_CAUSE_IDENTIFIED: reserved for fully supported specific procedural/payload cause; never infer from hash inequality alone

output_schema.result/run_identity.json: source and new auth commit identities
output_schema.result/input_identity.json: necessary array and H hashes and layout
output_schema.result/partition_payload.canonical.json: exact bytes hashed; no trailing newline
output_schema.result/scientific_call_observations.json: listed Python function profile counts; not C/global call certificate
output_schema.result/failure.json: on mismatch or exception; original traceback on exception
output_schema.result/secondary_failures.json: optional logger/preservation failures; does not overwrite primary
output_schema.result/terminal.json: classification, expected exit, usage, mandatory STOP
output_schema.result/runner_output_inventory.json: all files at runner terminal excluding self
output_schema.raw_logs_and_outer_exit: copied from dedicated runtime after process exit; final preservation inventory covers them

runtime_identity: environment_identity.json; same existing C1-1 interpreter/dependencies; no additions or switching
resources: no CPU/RAM/worker caps imposed; existing BLAS defaults; dependency chain and immediate stop; no unnecessary basis reconstruction
authorization_basis: current user D0 request explicitly authorizes both preparation and one diagnosis; no second permission needed
post_outcome: preserve and publish any outcome, verify public bytes and protections, mandatory STOP; never resume C1-1 basis/exact work
